task: Cover the library search page (`/`). As the reader types, the results list shows the titles containing the typed text and the status line reads `N results for "text"` (`1 result` for one); when nothing matches, `No titles match` is shown. Typing quickly must never leave results from an earlier, shorter query on screen: the list always reflects what is in the box now. Searches of three or more characters are added to Recent searches, newest first, without duplicates, and are still there after a reload; clicking a recent search runs it again. Clearing the box clears the results and the status.

faults.brief_phrase: the results list shows the titles containing the typed text
never leave results from an earlier, shorter query on screen
faults.description: A slow response for a short earlier query overwrites the results of the current longer query.
Recent searches are returned with each search response but the server does not keep them; a reload shows none.
Repeating a search adds it to Recent searches again.

faults.brief_phrase: Clearing the box clears the results and the status
faults.description: Clearing the box empties the list but leaves the previous status line.
